checks: Complete migration chain and critical relation RLS
Populated real-schema upgrade preserves orders/reviews/transactions/providers/categories byte-for-byte and quarantines historical IN_FLIGHT
Actual legacy schema denies browser token access and fabricated online payments
Security schema: actual signup trigger ignores user_metadata role escalation
Security schema: real profile ACL/trigger and admin RPC reject customer
Security schema: private documents deny direct browser upload/read even to owner; transfers require validated server route; other user/path spoofing denied
Security schema: anonymous document access denied; private bucket MIME/size configuration verified (not Storage HTTP)
Prelaunch: anonymous interest access and admin aggregates denied; new providers unpublished by default
Prelaunch: verified email, versioned consent, real persistence, deduplication, RLS and idempotent withdrawal
Prelaunch: persistent five-per-hour limit blocks repeated consent submissions
Prelaunch: classification required; reserved seed cannot publish; sandbox reviews never become social proof
Prelaunch: compare-and-clear announcement is admin-only, audited and leaves maintenance unchanged

Control: real unpublish transaction changes publication only, admin badge source hidden, anon list/detail row absent, public gate absent, one audit; nonadmin denied; replay deduplicated; stale admin version rejected
Control: republish, deactivate, activate, unverify, test/real classification, quality decisions, profile editing, evidence enforcement; audit insert failure rolls back provider and receipt
Control: server pagination, literal search, empty result distinguished, invalid page size/provider/action, persistent rate limit
Partner independent writes: calendar leaves complete service price/scope rows unchanged; services preserve latest hours; other users cannot call either focused RPC

Marketplace 3: service-only health metadata includes actual gallery RLS/policies; private wrappers denied; admin-only aggregates cover all active categories/districts; verified prepared real profiles count separately from publication; test classification removes readiness without deleting services; actual application status retained

Partner: own profile/service price/scope/calendar persist and requeue publication; other owner/readiness/store denied; own identity/admin escalation and audit mutation denied; document path spoof rejected
Partner: private document attachment persists, reopens application review, removes old identity/professional approval; explicit EXECUTE grants; actual missing RPC fails without fallback
Control concurrency: two actual PostgreSQL sessions with the same version allow one decision and reject one conflict; simultaneous identical request creates one audit and one receipt

Trust documents: real ownership/role escalation denial, verified-phone INSERT, upload receipt required, typed immutable versions, resubmit reason visible, stale/superseded review denied, identity evidence and access audit without content/path
Trust requirements: expired approval denied, missing Storage distinguished, inaccessible object denied, qualification from different category cannot verify provider

Trust publication: draft activation denied; versioned official-source rule editable without code; missing reviewed requirement blocks actual publication decision; explicit rule retirement permits reviewed publication

Service code: CSPRNG six digits, bcrypt only in existing code row, no browser secret SELECT, wrong customer/provider rejected, wrong code, single use, provider completion waits for explicit customer confirmation; pending scope blocks completion, only customer can accept scope/extra price, original financial snapshot preserved

Service abuse: five attempts persisted, sixth does not reset counter, expired code, wrong order code, cancelled order rejected; customer complaint pauses order, separate provider appeal, other user cannot read cases, reversible admin resolution never impersonates customer consent; all flows work without any location input
Service atomicity: two independent PostgreSQL connections consume same order/code concurrently; exactly one succeeds and one transition/audit persists under row locks
Trust audit fail-closed: simulated audit INSERT outage rolls back code generation; every trust RPC denies anon and has explicit empty search_path and SECURITY DEFINER boundary
